_comment: The simulated ePixQuad 1 kfps for psdaq.sim.rogue_dev: the KCU (lcls2_pgp_pcie_apps.DevRoot on the PCIe map, root 'DevRoot') and the camera behind SRPv3 on its PGP lane (ePixQuad.Top, root 'Top'), which psdaq/configdb/epixquad1kfps_config.py builds (its ePixQuad.Top also maps the PCIe card, root Top, AxiPcieCore). Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the hardware reports.
_Locked: what the timing receiver reports once its clocks and link are up: ConfigLclsTimingV2's LockProc waits for MmcmLocked == 3 and RxLinkUp == 1
_RxId: the XPM's remote link id; the DRP takes the link id simxpm assigns, not this one
_AdcTestDone: the camera's Microblaze has finished its ADC startup test (AdcTestFailed reads 0): epixquad_config's _checkADCs polls it at Configure

Top.AxiPcieCore.AxiVersion.BuildStamp.string: Lcls2XilinxKcu1500Pgp4_10Gbps: Vivado v2023.1, rdsrv (Ubuntu 20.04), Built Mon Jan  1 00:00:00 PST 2024 by sim

_AxiPcieCore: ePixQuad.Top.start checks the PCIe card's image name (one of its supported Lcls2...Pgp4_10Gbps images) and FpgaVersion >= 0x04020000
